title: AR/VR Developer
description: A roadmap for immersive app development with Unity, AR Foundation, XR interaction, 3D UX, performance, and publishable demos.

tree.name: 3D and Unity Foundations
tree.description: Learn Unity basics, C#, 3D scenes, cameras, lighting, input, prefabs, physics, and build workflows.

resources.title: Project-Based Augmented Reality Course with Unity (freeCodeCamp)
Make an AR App in 15 Minutes (immersive insiders)

children.name: C# for Unity
children.description: Write MonoBehaviours, events, coroutines, ScriptableObjects, state machines, and reusable gameplay scripts.

children.name: 3D UX Basics
children.description: Understand scale, comfort, spatial UI, motion sickness, interaction distance, and visual hierarchy.

tree.name: AR and VR Tooling
tree.description: Build AR experiences with tracking/planes and VR experiences with headsets, controllers, and XR interaction.

resources.title: Learn VR Development in 3 Hours (Valem Tutorials)

children.name: AR Foundation
children.description: Use plane detection, anchors, raycasting, image tracking, light estimation, and mobile AR builds.

children.name: XR Interaction Toolkit
children.description: Implement grabbing, teleportation, locomotion, hands/controllers, UI interaction, and haptic feedback.

children.name: Practice: Comfort Review Session
children.description: Test an immersive flow for motion sickness, reachability, onboarding, frame rate, and interaction clarity.

tree.name: Performance and Portfolio
tree.description: Optimize frame rate, assets, interaction comfort, and create immersive demos that recruiters can try.

children.name: WebXR Optional Path
children.description: Learn browser-based immersive experiences with WebXR, Three.js, device APIs, and progressive support.

children.name: Project: Immersive Product Demo
children.description: Build an AR product viewer or VR training demo with onboarding, interaction, performance testing, and recorded walkthrough.

tree.name: Testing and Distribution
tree.description: Validate immersive experiences on real devices, reduce user discomfort, and package demos for review or stores.

children.name: Immersive Usability Testing
children.description: Test comfort, onboarding, reachability, interaction errors, motion sickness, accessibility, and session length.

children.name: Device Builds and Store Prep
children.description: Create Android/iOS/Quest builds, optimize assets, handle permissions, record walkthroughs, and prepare release notes.
